companions._source: superpowers 7.0.2 SKILL.md descriptions, copied 2026-11-13; the companions the README names. Update when a new version changes one.
companions.superpowers:brainstorming: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, modifying behavior, or planning anything new, in software or out of it (a talk, a business, a renovation).
companions.superpowers:writing-plans: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
companions.superpowers:executing-plans: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available
companions.superpowers:requesting-code-review: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
companions.superpowers:verification-before-completi: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
companions.superpowers:systematic-debugging: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
